statement: At pinned SDL revision d4557c1511c721485dc4960f7149730afc9a73a0, the Linux evdev auto-mapper directly recognizes BTN_GRIPR, BTN_GRIPL, BTN_GRIPR2 and BTN_GRIPL2 as the respective right and left paddle slots, matching the key codes that Linux v7.3 xpad advertises for the original Elite. If these direct keys are not all mapped, the later SDL source retains a separate Microsoft-only legacy BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY5 through BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY8 fallback. This is source-level compatibility, not a tested active SDL mapping.

applicability.revision: SDL d4557c1511c721485dc4960f7149730afc9a73a0 Linux evdev versus Linux v7.3 xpad
applicability.scope: SDL_sysjoystick.c:78-100, 2739-2795; xpad.c:470-475, 2001-2005. Paddle key-code compatibility only. Actual SDL version, mapping database precedence, backend selection and physical paddle delivery are not tested.
